answer: 전부 비공개로 진행할 것이고, repo가 통합되거나 분리되면서, 기존에 repo 정책에 기반하여 얼마든지 바뀔 수 있다.
meaning: Conduct the entire reorganization privately. Existing repository topology and policies can change with justified integration or separation; the present public/private layout is not a fixed target. Existing public repositories were observed, not changed in this preparation session.
